# Data Source: catalyst_stratus_bucket_cors

Read the cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) rules for an existing Stratus bucket using the official JavaScript SDK read contract. Requires project access and permission to read bucket CORS. This data source has offline verification.

-> **Note:** This data source reads existing infrastructure. It does not create
or modify the service. Select the matching project, data center and environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    catalyst = {
      source = "edson-edwin/catalyst"
    }
  }
}

data "catalyst_stratus_bucket_cors" "existing" {
  project_id  = "123456789"
  bucket_name = "example-bucket"
}

output "bucket_cors_rules" {
  value = data.catalyst_stratus_bucket_cors.existing.rules
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Argument Reference

### Required

- `bucket_name` (String) Existing lowercase Stratus bucket name.
- `project_id` (String) Existing Catalyst project's positive numeric ID as a string.

## Attribute Reference

- `rules` (Attributes List) Rules sorted by domain and method list. A successful response without rules returns an empty list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_methods` (List of String) Allowed HTTP methods sorted lexicographically.
- `domain` (String) Origin reported by Catalyst.
